title: Goldman sees US data center growth intact despite opposition
key_facts: Goldman Sachs says rising political opposition has had limited near-term effect on US data center growth through 2027.
It raised its year-end 2026 US capacity forecast by 5 GW to 64 GW and cut year-end 2027 by 5 GW to 90 GW, in a note on Sunday.
It forecasts US data center power demand up 38% (12 GW) in 2026 and 38% (17 GW) in 2027.
A June Reuters/Ipsos poll: a third of Americans approve of the pace of construction; 14% would support one in their own community for AI.
Reuters says the backlash is a political challenge for Republicans before the 3 Nov midterms.
